name: First results from the LUX dark matter experiment at the Sanford Underground Research Facility
notes: significance is null: this is an exclusion limit.

summary.plain: In its first months of running, LUX saw no dark matter and set the strictest limit of the time. It also disagreed sharply with hints of light dark matter reported by several other experiments.
summary.technical: WS2013: 85.3 live days, 118 kg fiducial volume, April-August 2013. Data consistent with background only; minimum 90% CL spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross section limit 7.6e-46 cm2 at 33 GeV/c2, in strong disagreement with low-mass WIMP interpretations of other experiments.

title: First results from the LUX dark matter experiment at the Sanford Underground Research Facility
why_it_matters: LUX's first run set the tightest spin-independent WIMP limit of its time and contradicted the low-mass dark matter signals several other experiments had reported, reshaping the field's view of those claims.
